<function name="SetStretchHeight" parent="DIconLayout" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
If set to true, the icon layout will stretch its height to fit all the children.

See also <page>DIconLayout:SetStretchWidth</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="do_stretch" type="boolean"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
